title: TensorPlate Worker Status
description: Status payload published by `tensorplate-serving` and consumed by `tensorplate-agent`, the CLI, and `tensorplate-observability`. The same fields populate the V01-E10 ROS 2 `diagnostic_msgs/msg/DiagnosticArray` health topic.

agent_state.description: Coarse `tensorplate-agent` state. `unknown` is emitted before the agent reports for the first time.

serving_state.description: Coarse serving-worker state. Drives ROS 2 health-topic level mapping (`ready` -> OK, `degraded` -> WARN, `failed` -> ERROR).

observability_state.description: Coarse observability-service state. `failed` here implies operator-visible loss of health signal but does not by itself fail the device.

active_deployment.description: `deployment_id` of the currently-active deployment. Empty if no deployment has been promoted.

backend.description: Backend name in use, e.g. `tensorrt`, `libtorch`, `python_pytorch`. Empty when no model is loaded.

missed_heartbeat_count.description: Cumulative missed heartbeat count since the worker started. Reset on worker restart.

missed_deadline_rate.description: Fraction of requests whose deadline was missed in the most-recent rolling window. Range [0, 1].

last_error_code.description: Most-recent typed error code seen by the worker. Absent if the worker is healthy.
